options.title: Blocked Account
options.description: A special bank account where you deposit the required amount, from which you can withdraw a limited monthly sum (€934).

options.title: Scholarship
options.description: Proof of a recognized scholarship from a German or international organization.

options.title: Verpflichtungserklärung (Declaration of Commitment)
options.description: A formal pledge from someone residing in Germany with sufficient income to cover your living costs.

stages.title: Travel Health Insurance
stages.description: Required for the visa application from abroad, covering your journey and initial days until university enrollment.

stages.title: Student Health Insurance
stages.description: Required for university enrollment. Usually statutory public insurance (e.g. TK, AOK, Barmer) or acceptable private alternative.
